scalar_control: Raw histories multiplied by the mean training retention of each source model; never chosen from forecast validation scores
normalization: StandardScaler per historical lag; fit on the inner training prefix only for each fold, then on all 251 training histories for final readout. Never per-window normalize or normalize future targets.

inner_folds.scheme: Expanding chronological prefixes; contiguous future validation blocks; train target end must be at or before first inner validation origin

selection: Lowest pooled inner-fold pointwise MSE; scores tied within max(1e-12, 1e-10*abs(minimum)) choose larger alpha. No outer-validation selection or adaptive grid expansion.
numerical_controls: Check final SVD readout against float64 Cholesky; standardized scalar controls should reproduce raw input transforms, selected alpha and outer predictions
outer_baseline: Yesterday same time, raw unprocessed history; no fitting
evaluation: Existing 54 validation windows only, same raw future targets; no test windows
interpretation: Conditional readout calibration of already trained frozen representations, not nested validation of the whole learned preprocessing pipeline
known_limits: Source representations were learned using all outer training labels, including this round's inner validation portions
Source neural checkpoints were selected with the existing outer validation set
Original series standardization and SSA used the existing outer-training setup, not refitted upstream per inner fold
All four task cases are reported to avoid picking only the previously best one
Three seeds reflect source neural training variation, not independent datasets
No clean-signal recovery or novel denoising claim
